WHERE (((adchecks.qtyp)="מרשם סופי" Or (adchecks.qtyp)="מרשם נסיוני") And ((adchecks.caddate)=IIf(nz(Forms!person_orders_list!mwdate)<>"",Forms!person_orders_list!mwdate,[dt])))
ORDER BY adchecks.bdikanum DESC;
